description.value: Peaceful Restaurant is a Northern Chinese restaurant chain founded in 1998 by owner and executive chef Charlie Huang, specializing in hand-pulled noodles, dumplings, artisanal dim sum, and beef rolls. The Port Coquitlam location is part of a multi-branch Metro Vancouver operation that has been recognized by the Food Network and USA Today for its distinctive Xi'an-influenced cuisine. A touring cyclist would find a full sit-down dining experience with online ordering available for the Port Coquitlam branch.
